_comment: Wilderness vegetation kits (trees spec, Requirement 1). Keyed by a biome's 'vegetation_kit' id in biomes.json. 'density' is trees per 1,000,000 square units of Eligible_Ground for each level except 'none'. 'groves' shapes the clustering: lone_share of trees stand alone, the rest grow in groves of trees_per_grove within radius. Species heights and canopy widths are world units at scale 1; colours are the GLB preview base colours and the texture palette; descriptions are the texture-prompt hints. Starting values from the measured Karanas (trees design 'Research findings'); tuned in task 11.

plains_grassland.description: Karana grassland trees: broadleaf groves with scattered conifers and saplings
